about: How a reading is built (unit-prep design section 6.2). Readings publish text-first; art is a last pass.

skeleton.rule: A passage set in the card's setting and on the card's reading topic.
One card per reading word the card lists, at most ten.
Comprehension questions, each answerable from the text.

drafter_rules: Give each new word of the passage a vocabulary card: at most 10, counting the card's reading words, each a core word for the unit's level that fits the reading topic.
Every other passage word was taught before this reading.
Every passage word has a glossary row or a dictionary entry.
Names, cognates and sound words may appear without a card.
Each comprehension question is answerable from the text.
A different form of a word already taught gets a gloss row, never a card, with the fields fr, en and note.

basis.size.new_words: jake:2026-11-25 readings teach at most ten words of their own
basis.mix.typical: every reading question is a comprehension question
